turns.user: review flagged xss in search.php, last line. fix it

assistant.body: Replacing the raw echo with htmlspecialchars so the value is escaped defensively. ENT_QUOTES covers single quotes too, and the third argument pins the charset to UTF-8.

turns.user: is ENT_QUOTES on its own enough? we had this page go blank once on some junk input

assistant.body: Great question! That blank page was invalid UTF-8 being rejected. ENT_SUBSTITUTE keeps the bad bytes from emptying the whole string.
